name: CSO_TAG
description: This table contains the tags that are used to store categories, user groups.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the date that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the date that the record was modified.

columns.name: LOOKUP_CODE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID used to identify the type of tag

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID for the parent tag

columns.name: OWNER_SITE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID for the repository the tag belongs to

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: the string used to identify hierarchy of the tag

columns.name: SORT_ORDER
columns.description: The numeric sort order for tags.

columns.name: OBJECT_COUNT
columns.description: This is the number of children tags.

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: This is the ID to the parent tag.

columns.name: REFERENCE_KEY
columns.description: The referenc key used to identify the tag from the tag library.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: This is the comment for the column EXTERNAL_ID.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_TYPE
columns.description: This is the comment for the column EXTERNAL_TYPE.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM, HCM, or PRM.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: The inventory item that the article is tagged to.

columns.name: BU_ORG_IDS_1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. This column value indicates the Business Units assigned to this UserGroup.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
